blindSummary:
This state/province holds the most severe documented trans-related violence in the national record: on 23 June 2025, in its largest city, a hooded gunman shot a transgender rights activist and radio commentator several times at the acupuncture clinic she owned and fled on a motorcycle; police said they were investigating whether her history of activism was connected to the killing. An international human-rights organisation called it an "apparent targeted killing". The national human-rights commission publicly condemned the killings of two transgender women as "marked by cruelty and impunity" — an official body using the word impunity.

No protective ordinance, institutional counterweight or arrest in this killing is documented; the unresolved case is counted within the national series of six killings with arrests in at least three of them, none reported prosecuted to conviction.
